instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Node.js 20 Express application.
- package.json and package-lock.json are present
- Entry point is server.js
- Port 3000
output:
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Node.js 20 Next.js production build.
- Build stage runs npm run build
- Final stage runs npm start
- Port 3000
output:
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/.next ./.next
COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=builder /app/package.json ./
COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["npm", "start"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Node.js 20 Vite React app served by nginx.
- Build stage runs npm run build producing dist/
- Final stage uses nginx:alpine to serve static files
- Port 80
output:
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=builder /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Node.js 20 app using pnpm.
- pnpm-lock.yaml is present
- Entry is src/index.ts compiled to dist/
- Port 3000
output:
FROM node:20-slim AS builder
RUN npm install -g pnpm
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
COPY . .
RUN pnpm run build

FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=builder /app/package.json ./
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Node.js 18 app with a custom non-root user.
- App files in /app
- Run as user node
- Port 3000
output:
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
RUN chown -R node:node /app
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

instruction:
Write a multi-stage Dockerfile for a Node.js 20 app that needs native compilation.
- Builder installs python3, make, g++ for node-gyp
- Final image is alpine slim
- Port 3000
output:
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
RUN apk add --no-cache python3 make g++
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=builder /app/package.json ./
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
